name: logseq-harbor-connect
description: Connect Claude Desktop to every Logseq MCP graph behind the Harbor proxy. Graphs are discovered from /mcp; tool names are prefixed with the graph name.

logseq_proxy_url.title: Logseq proxy URL
logseq_proxy_url.description: The root address of the Harbor reverse proxy. Graphs are read from its /mcp list. Example: http://127.0.0.1:8080

logseq_api_token.title: Logseq MCP token
logseq_api_token.description: The logseq_mcp_token value from the Harbor config.yaml. Claude Desktop stores this as a sensitive value.
